reviews.title: unsafe, PLEASE do not use!
reviews.text: this app actively logs and tracks your data, including the information you have input previously before even installing the app. if you don't believe me, there's a built-in apple warning for this app when you download it and go into your settings that reads, "when using one of these keyboards, the keyboard can access all the data you type." there's an additional warning when you enable this setting that warns you EXPLICITLY that this app can log your bank account details, credit card numbers, addresses, and more. this is a VERY large safety risk, and i would highly suggest not using keyboards such as this because of the insane vulnerabilities.
